title: Campfire Guitar
summary: A focused beginner path to play simple songs confidently around a campfire.

techniques.title: Guitar Basics
techniques.description: Learn posture, pick grip, tuning, and clean fretting so every practice session starts well.
techniques.reason: Gives you a reliable setup before learning songs.

techniques.title: Essential Chords
techniques.description: Build the core open chord vocabulary used in hundreds of beginner-friendly songs.
techniques.reason: Most campfire songs depend on a small set of open chords.

techniques.title: Chord Transitions
techniques.description: Move between common chords smoothly without stopping the song.
techniques.reason: Smooth chord transitions let you play complete songs without stopping.

techniques.title: Strumming Patterns
techniques.description: Learn two reliable strumming patterns that work for relaxed singalongs.
techniques.reason: A steady strum makes simple chords sound like music.

techniques.title: Rhythm
techniques.description: Practice timing with a metronome and learn how to recover when you miss a beat.
techniques.reason: Rhythm keeps people singing with you.

techniques.title: First Complete Song
techniques.description: Combine chords, transitions, and strumming into one complete performance.
techniques.reason: Finishing one song builds confidence and reveals what to polish next.
